source_ref: PaxDb whole-organism integrated protein abundance joined to NCBI RefSeq R64 CDS codon counts, plus GtRNAdb sacCer3 tRNA gene-copy FASTA parsed as anticodon copy counts
observed_fact: 5815 Saccharomyces cerevisiae joined per-gene rows provide CDS codon counts and protein abundance; GtRNAdb provides 41 anticodon copy-count keys for the same organism-level yeast context.
resolution: per-gene CDS codon-count vector, abundance_ppm, cds_len_nt, and organism-level anticodon gene-copy counts
known_noise_or_bias: PaxDb abundance is integrated proteomics with dataset weighting; CDS-to-PaxDb joins depend on identifier matching; tRNA gene-copy count is a proxy for supply and does not measure charging, modification, expression, ribosome dwell, or condition-specific translation.
can_test: codon/abundance cross-layer association after a tRNA supply and CDS-length residual baseline
whether codon wobble tension rho explains protein-abundance residuals beyond a gene-permutation Null95 baseline
cross_layer_relation: statistical association between codon usage and protein abundance under stated residual baseline
cannot_test: does not establish translation mechanism, folding, function, causality, or organism-wide biological law
does not test A-P-site dwell or tRNA modification dynamics
null_reason: Shuffle rho across genes and refit Q(rho)=c1*rho+c2*rho^2; support requires observed residual explanatory gain to exceed 95% of this permutation null.
